description: Wind Energy Projects: 2004-2015 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. Table lists existing and proposed major wind projects in NYS, their locations, relative electric generating potential (project nameplate size), and project status (proposed, in-construction, or operational). Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Energy & Environment. Its tags are wind energy projects, wind. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Public Service Commission. The portal shows 2015-12-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
